senses.gloss: f. (רְבֵי II) lying, natural position, overlapping. Ḥall. 46ᵇ bot. היינו רְבִיתַיְיהוּ such is their natural position (and an adhesion is not necessarily the result of a wound, v. Tosaf. a. l.; v. preced.).—
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 76a:1">Yeb. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>שלא במקום רבותא</he> Ar. (missing in ed., obviously a gloss ref. to Ḥull. l. c.) not where the lungs overlap.
